item.title: Patch: Unauthenticated Authentication Bypass in Splunk Enterprise
item.description:
Splunk Enterprise: Authentication bypass · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Splunk Enterprise. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

High · Fix available
